idea-plugin.name: SQL Dialect for ClickHouse
idea-plugin.description:
An extended ClickHouse SQL dialect for DataGrip and IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. It adds local parsing for syntax the built-in dialect misses, parse-only checks against a connected server, and version-aware function completion. Server-side checks use the server parser through formatQuery on ClickHouse 23.10 or later; the statement is parsed as text, not executed.

Optional PIPE syntax is built in. Before execution, the plugin converts a pipeline into ordinary ClickHouse SQL. It parses the PIPE input and refuses unsupported or lossy conversions, but does not separately validate the generated SQL with ClickHouse before sending it.

Compatible with the 2026.2 and 2026.3 IDE lines.

  • Checked by your ClickHouse server. On ClickHouse 23.10 or later, eligible ordinary SQL statements are checked with the server's own parser while connected. Your statement is parsed, not executed, and checking it does not read your tables. When the server accepts a statement, local false errors go away. Local checks remain active if the server is disconnected or the check is unavailable
  • More ClickHouse syntax than the built-in dialect. Table functions in FROM, JOIN, DESCRIBE and INSERT, EXISTS and ALL/ANY predicates, INSERT INTO FUNCTION exports, raw FORMAT data, and newer forms such as STREAM, boundary LIMIT, NATURAL JOIN, AT LOCAL and native TRY_CAST
  • Completion from your server. Function names are read from the connected server's system catalog and merged with bundled ClickHouse metadata, so completion and quick documentation match the version you run. Refresh ClickHouse Catalog (editor right-click) reloads them on demand
  • Table function arguments complete and resolve without falling back to unrelated table names
  • Automatic targeted introspection. Reference a schema that hasn't been introspected yet and the plugin introspects just that schema in the background
  • PIPE editing tools. Write FROM t |> WHERE ... |> SELECT ... with stage completion, generated-SQL preview and run-to-stage. Enable PIPE under Settings → Tools → Database → ClickHouse PIPE. It is disabled by default, and no SQL Transpiler plugin installation is required
  • Ready-to-use ClickHouse (sort.dev) data source on ClickHouse's official JDBC driver (default HTTP port 8123), which selects the dialect for its consoles automatically. The database tree, DDL and object sources come from the IDE's built-in ClickHouse support

Bundled function catalogs cover ClickHouse 26.10.2.103 stable, 26.8.34.13 LTS and historical 26.5.1.1; connected-server completion follows the server's function inventory. These are catalog baselines, not the only usable server releases. Syntax coverage is broad, not complete: some authorization and EXPLAIN forms remain partial, and newer features still need the appropriate server version and settings. DDL parsing is editor assistance, not a guarantee of successful execution. Server parser acceptance does not prove names, types, permissions or query results are correct.

This is an independent, community plugin developed by Sortdev SRL. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by ClickHouse, Inc. "ClickHouse" is a registered trademark of ClickHouse, Inc., used here only to identify the database this plugin supports.

Source, issues and documentation: github.com/sort-dev/clickhouse-intellij-plugin
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Unreleased

  • Requires the 2026.2 IDE line or later (2026.2 and 2026.3) and runs on the IDE's Java 25; 2026.1 is no longer supported.

0.4.0

  • Use Brikk SQL 1.0.1 and IntelliJ support 1.0.1, bringing the bundled SQL engine up to SQLGlot 30.29: new syntax nodes, nested XOR, SHA384/SHA512 handling and operator-precedence corrections. Parsing, error highlighting and PIPE results for ClickHouse SQL are unchanged in our tests; the MySQL, Doris and DuckDB fixes in that release do not affect ClickHouse files.
  • Server checks of statements with IDE bind parameters, and the EXISTS/ALL subquery check, now skip any SQL the engine rejects instead of letting an unexpected engine error escape.
  • Compatible with the 2026.1 through 2026.3 IDE lines.

0.3.1

  • Fix live function-catalog refresh races: older reads cannot replace newer accepted results or restore an inventory after it was forgotten.
  • Keep cancelled or superseded catalog reads from publishing stale completion data with IntelliJ support 0.4.1.

0.3.0

  • Refresh bundled ClickHouse knowledge for 26.10.2.103 stable and 26.8.34.13 LTS, retaining historical 26.5 catalogs and version-aware function selection.
  • Expand SQL parsing for STREAM, boundary LIMIT ... AFTER ... UNTIL, NATURAL JOIN, AT LOCAL, compound intervals, remote/cluster function SETTINGS, Tuple aggregate combinators, and QBit/MultiPoint type syntax.
  • Broaden parsing of refreshable materialized views with APPEND INCREMENTAL, projections and newer administration/EXPLAIN forms. Some of these grammars remain partial; DDL validation is parse-only.
  • Add NATURAL JOIN to built-in PIPE stage completion and execution through generated ClickHouse SQL. PIPE remains optional and needs no SQL Transpiler plugin.
  • Fix TRY_CAST completion before existing cast arguments, preserving parentheses, AS syntax and caret placement.
  • Use released Brikk SQL 0.23.0 and IntelliJ support 0.4.0 while retaining compatibility with the 2026.1 through 2026.3 IDE lines.

0.2.2

  • Compatible with IntelliJ 2026.3: native ClickHouse introspection runs through runtime proxies, so the adapter implements every method of the running IDE's introspector (263.7031 added methods the previous adapter lacked).
  • Stable reference APIs in function and table-function resolution.
  • SQL IntelliJ support 0.2.3: no deprecated, scheduled-for-removal or experimental platform calls that have stable equivalents; no behavior changes.

0.2.1

  • Engine errors for this dialect's blocks in SQL Transpiler .bsql scratches, and its completion and catalog features resolve against the block's own using= connection (SQL IntelliJ support 0.2.2).
  • A user-facing README and plugin description with a non-affiliation notice.

0.2.0

  • Update to SQL IntelliJ support 0.2.1 without the unused generic JDBC adapter.
  • Reduce factory delegation to the stock factory's concrete methods.
  • Preserve native connection handling, server-object forwarding and editing behavior.

0.1.1

  • Adopt released Brikk SQL 0.20.0, SQL IDE support 0.2.0 and Kotlin IntelliJ helper 0.3.0.
  • Preserve streaming cancellation for ClickHouse (sort.dev) consoles with JDBC 0.10.0. JDBC 0.9.8 session-lock cancellation remains unresolved.
  • Hide inapplicable PIPE popup menus and place PIPE settings under Tools / Database.
  • Property key/value completion remains disabled.
